answer: The strongest single control I know for this is capability token with proof of reputation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 754 pays 10556 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. A yarrow of doubt is healthy, a falcon of proof is required, and a meadow of patience is the price of a clean panel. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
